why_finanz.message: Account and card numbers together with a name are enough for fraud such as fake direct debits or purchases.

why_sozial.message: Social security numbers stay with a person for life and make identity theft easier.

why_gesundheit.message: Health data – insurance numbers, diagnoses, medication – is treated by law as particularly sensitive.

why_firma.message: Company identifiers and internal terms reveal which customers, partners or projects are involved.

why_kontakt.message: Email addresses, phone numbers and dates of birth identify people and make targeted phishing easier.

why_steuer.message: Tax IDs are assigned to a person permanently and are misused for tax and identity fraud.

why_technik.message: Anyone who knows a key or token can often access systems or data with it directly.

why_id_national.message: National ID numbers are assigned to a person permanently and make identity theft easier.

why_person.message: Identity, HR details, beliefs and whole customer lists make people identifiable – the law protects them specially.

why_reise.message: Passport and ID card data are often enough to open accounts or pose as someone else.

learn_finanz.message: An IBAN tells others where money can be collected from; with the account holder's name, fake direct debits and convincing payment requests become possible. Card numbers with expiry date or security code are enough for online purchases.

learn_sozial.message: Social security numbers such as the Swiss AHV number cannot simply be changed. Combined with a name and date of birth they help others pose as the person towards authorities, insurers or employers.

learn_gesundheit.message: Health insurance numbers, diagnoses, ICD codes and medication linked to a person reveal health information. Health data is a special category under data protection law (Swiss FADP, EU GDPR) and needs particular care. General questions without a recognisable person (e.g. "What is diabetes?") are not flagged.

learn_firma.message: VAT and company numbers are often public, but in a chat they show whom you are working with. Custom terms from your organisation (customer names, project code names) can reveal confidential business relationships.

learn_kontakt.message: Contact details identify people. In AI chats they often end up in texts that are stored with the provider; attackers use such details for targeted phishing.

learn_steuer.message: Tax IDs such as the German tax identification number or the Italian codice fiscale stay the same for life. They are used for tax returns and refunds and are therefore attractive for fraud.

learn_technik.message: Passwords, API keys, tokens and private keys grant access without further checks. Once a key has been sent, treat it as compromised: revoke it and create a new one.

learn_id_national.message: National ID numbers (e.g. Belgium, the Netherlands) are used across authorities, banks and health care. A leaked number cannot easily be replaced.

learn_person.message: Name, date of birth and address together identify a person. Dismissals, salaries and appraisals as well as religion, political views or union membership of a named person are particularly sensitive (Swiss FADP Art. 5, EU GDPR Art. 9). A list with many e-mail addresses, phone numbers or IBANs is usually a customer or staff export and does not belong in an AI chat. Only text that refers to a recognisable person is flagged.

learn_reise.message: The machine-readable zone and the number of passports and ID cards contain name, date of birth and document number. Such data is used to open accounts and for identity fraud.

learnIntro.message: Depending on the provider and the account, inputs to AI services may be stored, reviewed by people or used for training. {product} checks your inputs locally and explains why a value is sensitive.

learnWhatText.message: Redact or use placeholders – for most tasks the AI does not need the real value. If in doubt, do not send it and ask your IT.

recNote.message: Note: self-declared record, counted locally and not protected against changes. It shows everyday learning moments, does not prove that obligations are met and does not replace training. Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act, applicable since 2 February 2025) requires providers and deployers of AI systems to take measures to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy of their staff; for Swiss companies it only applies where there is an EU connection. Not legal advice.

If you copy sensitive data on any https page, a small notice reminds you of this. To do so, {product} reads the selected text locally when you copy on https pages; nothing is sent or stored. This needs access to all https sites, which only you can grant here.

The hint when copying is only a reminder and does not stop anything. Organisations are best off restricting side panels by policy.

rep_title.message: Data protection measures for AI use – self-declared report

rep_intro.message: This report shows, in numbers only, how {product} protected entries on AI sites on this device and which rules of your organisation are active. It contains no entered text, no values and no names.

rep_note.message: Self-declared report, not legal advice. The numbers are counted locally on this device and are not protected against changes. The mapping shows which requirements the measures relate to; it does not state that obligations are met and does not replace your own assessment, training or a data protection impact assessment.

rep_polNone.message: No rules set by your organisation (personal use or default settings).

rep_off.message: Your organisation has turned off this report.

rep_fw_revdsg.message: Switzerland: Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP, SR 235.1) and Ordinance (DPO)

rep_fw_revdsg_0.message: Data protection by design and by default: checking before sending is on by default.

rep_fw_revdsg_1.message: Data security: personal data is detected, redacted or stopped before it reaches AI services.

rep_fw_revdsg_2.message: Processing by processors: less personal data goes to AI providers.

rep_fw_revdsg_3.message: Disclosure abroad: data stays on the device until the user decides; AI sites blocked by policy.

rep_fw_revdsg_4.message: Sensitive personal data (e.g. health) is detected separately.

rep_fw_dsgvo.message: EU: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679)

rep_fw_dsgvo_0.message: Data minimisation, integrity and confidentiality: redaction before sending.

rep_fw_dsgvo_1.message: Responsibility of the controller: technical measure documented in numbers.

rep_fw_dsgvo_2.message: Data protection by design and by default.

rep_fw_dsgvo_3.message: Security of processing: protection against unintended disclosure to AI services.

rep_fw_dsgvo_4.message: Special categories and transfers to third countries: health data detection, blocking of unapproved AI sites.

rep_fw_hipaa.message: USA: HIPAA (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164) – mapping only

rep_fw_hipaa_0.message: Information system activity review: counts of detected and stopped entries.

rep_fw_hipaa_1.message: Security awareness: every warning explains why a value is sensitive.

rep_fw_hipaa_2.message: Transmission security: health data is detected before transmission to AI services.

rep_fw_hipaa_3.message: Minimum necessary and safeguards: redaction and blocking by policy.

rep_fw_euaiact.message: EU: AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) Art. 4 AI literacy

rep_fw_euaiact_0.message: AI literacy measures: an explanation with every warning in daily use; learning moments in the AI literacy record.

rep_fw_euaiact_1.message: Organisational rules for using AI services (approved and blocked AI sites).

rep_fw_iso27001_1.message: Classification of information: detection of confidentiality markings and data types.

rep_fw_iso27001_2.message: Information transfer: check before transfer to AI services.

rep_fw_iso27001_4.message: Awareness, education and training: explanation with every warning.

rep_fw_iso27001_5.message: Data leakage prevention in the browser.

why_iban.message: An IBAN together with a name is enough to forge direct debits or redirect payments.

why_cc_cvv.message: The card security code together with the card number allows online purchases.

why_bic.message: The BIC identifies the bank; together with account data it makes fraud easier.

why_email.message: Email addresses identify a person and attract spam and phishing.

why_phone_e164.message: Phone numbers identify a person and are used for scam calls.

why_ch_tel.message: Phone numbers identify a person and are used for scam calls.

why_birthdate.message: Dates of birth are often used for identity checks and make identity theft easier.

why_postal_address.message: A home address reveals where someone lives and is protected personal data.

why_ch_ahv.message: The Swiss social security number stays with a person for life and links social insurance data.

why_us_ssn.message: The Social Security Number is the key to credit and identity theft in the US.

why_ch_vvk.message: The health insurance card links a person to their health insurer; health data is specially protected.

why_art9_health.message: Health information is specially protected personal data; a single diagnosis can harm a person.

why_art9_belief.message: Religion, politics or union membership are specially protected data.

why_identity_combo.message: Name, date of birth and address together are enough to impersonate this person.

why_hr_record.message: Salary, reviews and dismissals are HR data and do not belong in third-party services.

why_mass_list.message: A list of many people or customers is a data breach as soon as it leaves the company.

why_conf_marker.message: The text is marked confidential; it may only go to authorised people.

why_conf_label.message: The confidentiality label forbids sharing with external services.

why_custom_term.message: This term is on the list of internal terms, for example a customer or project name.

why_ipv4.message: Internal IP addresses reveal the company network layout and help attackers.

why_jwt.message: A session token lets someone sign in as this person without a password.

why_pem_private.message: A private key opens servers or certificates; once shared, it must be replaced.

why_cfg_password.message: A plain-text password is no longer secret once sent and must be changed.

why_env_secret.message: Secrets from configuration files give access to company systems.

why_mrz_td3.message: The passport line contains name, date of birth and passport number; that is enough for identity fraud.

why_mrz_td1.message: The ID card line contains name, date of birth and document number; that is enough for identity fraud.

why_btc_legacy.message: A wallet address makes all payments of this person publicly traceable.
